channel.title: Akira's Blog
channel.description: A personal blog about technology, reading, and everyday observations.

item.title: Bypassing the WPS Slideshow FPS Limit on Linux
item.description: A record of improving WPS Office PPT playback frame rate on Arch Linux by scaling QElapsedTimer and accelerating time with libfaketime.

item.title: Building a Raspberry Pi Kernel to Run dae
item.description: Enable the BPF stream parser and BTF support required by dae on Raspberry Pi by cross-compiling a Raspberry Pi 5 kernel from Arch Linux

item.title: Create a Virtual Screen in KDE for Sunshine Streaming
item.description: Create a virtual screen in KDE to use a tablet as a secondary display via Sunshine streaming

item.title: Trying to Boot Arch Linux RISC-V on QEMU
item.description: Attempt to run the RISC-V port of Arch Linux on QEMU using the rootfs provided by https://archriscv.felixc.at/

item.title: Running ros+gazebo+rviz with xwayland
item.description: Run ROS Noetic via Docker and display robot simulation GUI through XWayland under Arch Linux, including visualization support for Gazebo and RViz

item.title: RISC-V Interrupt and Exception Mechanism
item.description: Analyzes the interrupt and exception mechanism of RISC-V, including privilege modes, exception and interrupt types, control and status registers, and the handling process.

item.title: Writing a Simple Shell in C
item.description: A programming exercise to implement a shell in C, including basic execution of system executables, built-in commands, support for pipes and redirection, and script file execution.

item.title: Getting Started with Verilator
item.description: During the "Yi Sheng Yi Xin" learning phase, Verilator was used for simulation. Basic commands and usage were learned, and a waveform display template is provided.
